cards.name: Observed city-days
cards.sql: SELECT count(*) AS city_days FROM mart.weather_daily WHERE TRUE [[AND city = {{city}}]]

cards.name: Rainfall total (mm)
cards.sql: SELECT sum(precipitation) AS rainfall_mm FROM mart.weather_daily WHERE TRUE [[AND city = {{city}}]]

cards.name: Daily temperature midpoint (C)
cards.sql: SELECT observed_date, city, temp_midpoint FROM mart.weather_daily WHERE TRUE [[AND city = {{city}}]] ORDER BY observed_date,city

cards.name: Rainfall by city (mm)
cards.sql: SELECT city,sum(precipitation) AS rainfall_mm FROM mart.weather_daily WHERE TRUE [[AND city = {{city}}]] GROUP BY city ORDER BY city

cards.name: Monthly weather summary
cards.sql: SELECT * FROM mart.weather_monthly WHERE TRUE [[AND city = {{city}}]] ORDER BY month,city
